name: Kilwins
description: Experience Kilwins: handcrafted fudge, caramel apples, ice cream, and more. Since 1947, Kilwins has promised to make the best possible chocolates, fudge, and ice cream. Our made-in-store products like hand-crafted waffle cones, Mackinac Island Fudge, caramel apples, caramel corn, brittle, and dozens of Kilwins Heritage Chocolate-dipped treats continue the tradition of offering a feast for the senses. Discover Kilwins, where the magic of hand-crafted confections and Original Recipe Ice Cream meet the warmth of exceptional service.
